summary.business_type: Local Service (hybrid: two street addresses + wide service area) — Czech arborist, Praha + Vimperk/Šumava
top_findings: Google Business Profile status unverifiable from outside; Firmy.cz/Mapy.cz listings use a generic landscaping category
No pricing content anywhere (0 'Kč' across 30 pages) against a SERP made up entirely of ceník pages
public/images/realizace is 193MB/60 files; 16 of 17 realization pages use a raw camera JPEG as LCP image
0 of 30 pages emit <link rel="canonical">; src/hooks/use-canonical-url.js is dead code
Three contradictory experience claims (14+ / 12+ / computed 15) plus foundingDate 2011 vs ARES 2020-09-17
quick_wins: Add alternates.canonical to every metadata export
Add the missing footer link for /sluzby/prorezavani-ovocnych-stromu (1 inlink vs ~30 for siblings)
Add /gdpr to sitemap.xml and fix stale lastmod on 9 URLs
Fix missing space in homepage H1 (src/components/Welcome.js:69-72)
Reconcile the experience number to one computed source

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: http→https and www→apex are single-hop 301s
Trailing slashes 308 to canonical form
Real 404 on unknown paths
Content fully server-rendered (static export)
robots.txt valid, sitemap declared

findings.title: No canonical tags on any page
findings.description: 0 of 30 pages emit <link rel="canonical">. src/hooks/use-canonical-url.js has zero call sites and no page sets alternates.canonical.
findings.recommendation: Add alternates.canonical to every metadata/generateMetadata export; delete the dead hook.

findings.title: No HSTS or CSP headers
findings.description: Confirmed absent via live curl on /, /robots.txt and a 404.
findings.recommendation: Add at the Cloudflare edge — a static export has no server runtime.

findings.title: Duplicate/conflicting robots meta
findings.description: src/app/layout.js:73 hardcodes a robots tag duplicating the metadata API output; on the 404 page this yields index,follow→noindex→index,follow.
findings.recommendation: Delete the hardcoded tag at src/app/layout.js:73.

findings.title: Service page orphaned from footer nav
findings.description: /sluzby/prorezavani-ovocnych-stromu has 1 inlink vs ~30 for its six siblings; src/layouts/Footer.js:48-88 hardcodes only 6 of 7 services.
findings.recommendation: Add the missing FooterLink.

findings.title: No BreadcrumbList anywhere
findings.description: Confirmed across all 30 pages.
findings.recommendation: Add to both [slug] routes.

findings.title: Legacy URL returns 404
findings.description: /inventarizace-drevin.html appears in search results and returns a genuine 404.
findings.recommendation: 301 to /sluzby/inventarizace-drevin.

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: All 30 titles and descriptions unique and keyword-targeted in Czech
Exactly one H1 per page
Real credentials (ETW, SZKT) and real named clients (ČEZ, Povodí Vltavy)
Readable prose — avg 13.5 words/sentence

findings.title: Zero cross-links between services and realizations
findings.description: Confirmed by grep of both index pages and both [slug] pages. Claim and proof live on pages with no path between them.
findings.recommendation: Add services:[] tags to src/data/realizations.js; render related blocks both directions.

findings.title: Service pages far below topical depth
findings.description: 142-200 words; site median 157. /sluzby/inventarizace-drevin at 169 words competes against long-form tender documentation.
findings.recommendation: Expand longDescription in src/data/arbo.js.

findings.title: Three unreconciled experience claims
findings.description: src/app/layout.js:9 and src/data/arbo.js:16 say 14+; src/app/kontakt/page.js:25 and o-nas/page.js:12,15 say 12+; src/components/Welcome.js:74 computes 15.
findings.recommendation: Derive all from one computed source.

findings.title: Trust signals homepage-only
findings.description: TrustSection imported only in src/app/page.js — not /o-nas or /kontakt.
findings.recommendation: Add credentials and a named practitioner bio to both.

findings.title: Realization pages structurally templated
findings.description: All 17 follow an identical 3-paragraph shape; measured word-level Jaccard 0.13 — structural repetition, not duplicate content.
findings.recommendation: Vary structure; add per-job measurements and quotes.

findings.title: Service CTA is not a crawlable link
findings.description: ServicePageClient.js:19-24,62-70 uses router.push; realizace/[slug]/page.js:138-146 already does it correctly.
findings.recommendation: Wrap in <NextLink href="/kontakt">.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: Zero duplicate titles or descriptions across 30 pages
Exactly one H1 everywhere
Czech keyword targeting is deliberate and well written

findings.title: Nine titles exceed 60 characters
findings.description: Homepage title is 74 chars; also o-nas 62, realizace 64, sluzby 61, likvidace 68, rizikove-kaceni 65, zajistovani 61, and two realization pages.
findings.recommendation: Trim to ~60 to avoid SERP truncation.

findings.title: Service page H2 is the brand name
findings.description: ServicePageClient.js:34 renders H2 = "Arbovert" on all 7 service pages.
findings.recommendation: Replace with a topical heading.

findings.title: Meta description lengths inconsistent
findings.description: 8 descriptions under 120 chars, 6 over 160.
findings.recommendation: Normalize to 140-155.

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: Valid JSON-LD, correct @context, no deprecated types
Server-rendered, not client-injected
LocalBusiness @type is the correct choice — schema.org has no arborist subtype

findings.title: Praha address missing required postalCode
findings.description: src/app/page.js:38-44 has no postalCode/addressRegion; /kontakt shows Jirsíkova 484/6, Praha 8, 180 00.
findings.recommendation: Add postalCode, correct addressLocality, add addressRegion.

findings.title: Business entity duplicated 8x with no @id
findings.description: Homepage LocalBusiness has no @id; src/app/sluzby/[slug]/page.js:70-75 re-declares a stub provider on all 7 service pages.
findings.recommendation: Add @id on the homepage entity; reference it from provider.

findings.title: sameAs links a different company
findings.description: src/app/page.js:100-103 links vyskoveprace-arbovert.cz, a separate facade/roof-work business sharing the brand.
findings.recommendation: Remove, or model as a sibling Organization.

findings.title: 17 case studies carry no structured data
findings.description: src/app/realizace/[slug]/page.js emits no JSON-LD despite ISO-8601 dated editorial content.
findings.recommendation: Add Article — template in findings/schema.md.

findings.title: geo coordinates are strings
findings.description: src/app/page.js:69-70,75-76 use "50.0755" rather than numbers, at 4-decimal precision.
findings.recommendation: Convert to numeric, extend to 5 decimals.

findings.title: No WebSite or BreadcrumbList schema
findings.description: Absent across all 30 pages.
findings.recommendation: Add both — templates in findings/schema.md.

findings.title: FAQPage no longer earns rich results
findings.description: Google retired FAQ rich results for all sites on 7 May 2026.
findings.recommendation: Keep as-is. Do not remove, do not extend.

categories.name: Performance (CWV)
what_works: Homepage hero is well optimized — Cloudinary f_auto/q_auto, preloaded, fetchpriority
System font stack, so no web-font loading risk
No missing image dimensions found

findings.title: Raw camera JPEGs as LCP images
findings.description: IMG_8291.jpg is 4032x3024 and 6.28MB (confirmed live via content-length), rendered into a 256-384px container, on 16 of 17 realization pages.
findings.recommendation: Re-encode public/images/realizace/* to ~1200-1600px WebP q75-80.

findings.title: Realization hero lacks priority and sizes
findings.description: src/app/realizace/[slug]/page.js:94-99, against Welcome.js:39-56 which does it correctly.
findings.recommendation: Add both attributes.

findings.title: Duplicate analytics
findings.description: GTM-5V7DRKB in providers.js:19-20 plus a separate GA4 gtag.js in page.js:117-129 both execute on the homepage.
findings.recommendation: Remove the redundant one.

findings.title: Weak image cache-control
findings.description: 4h max-age; cf-cache-status REVALIDATED rather than HIT.
findings.recommendation: Cloudflare cache rule for /images/*, 1 year immutable.

findings.title: No field data available
findings.description: No Google API credentials — no CrUX, no PageSpeed, no Lighthouse trace. No measured LCP/INP/CLS exists in this audit.
findings.recommendation: Connect Search Console and re-measure.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness
what_works: Homepage FAQ is genuinely citable — 5 self-contained answers of 67-95 words, one citing zákon č. 114/1992 Sb.
Content fully server-rendered, no JS dependency for crawlers
OAI-SearchBot and PerplexityBot are not blocked

findings.title: Cloudflare robots.txt blocks major AI crawlers
findings.description: Live robots.txt disallows GPTBot, ClaudeBot, CCBot, Google-Extended, Bytespider, Amazonbot, Applebot-Extended, meta-externalagent — overriding public/robots.txt, which allows all. All tested UAs returned 200 with identical content, so the block is declarative, not edge-enforced.
findings.recommendation: A Cloudflare dashboard setting, not a repo change. Confirm it matches business intent.

findings.title: Service pages are not citable
findings.description: Generic 140-200 word blurbs, no pricing, no named credentials, H2 is the brand name on all 7.
findings.recommendation: Add self-contained factual passages in the style of the homepage FAQ.

findings.title: No external brand-authority presence found
findings.description: No YouTube link on any page or in sameAs; site: searches for reddit/youtube/linkedin/wikipedia returned nothing before rate-limiting. Not exhaustive.
findings.recommendation: Build citable off-site presence.

findings.title: llms.txt absent
findings.description: Returns 404. Optional; Google ignores it.
findings.recommendation: No action required.

categories.name: Images
what_works: Every img on all 30 pages has a non-empty alt attribute
Kozel realization already uses ~300KB WebP — the pattern to copy

findings.title: 201MB of images in the repo
findings.description: public/images totals 201MB; realizace/ alone is 193MB across 60 files averaging 3.2MB. 49 of 97 files exceed 1MB. next.config.js sets unoptimized:true, so committed size is shipped size.
findings.recommendation: Pre-resize before commit, or move to Cloudinary as the hero already does.

findings.title: Portrait photos force-cropped into wide banners
findings.description: strom.webp is 1200x1800 displayed at 1920x320 with object-fit cover — roughly 85% of the frame discarded. Realization thumbnails are 3024x4032 shown at 464x256.
findings.recommendation: Crop deliberately at build time or set object-position.

categories.name: Local SEO (unweighted)
what_works: NAP identical across all 30 pages and the homepage JSON-LD
IČO 02059690 / DIČ CZ02059690 match ARES exactly
ETW certification displayed prominently
17 place-named realization pages do genuine geographic work

findings.title: GBP existence and category unverified
findings.description: Google Maps/Search served consent-wall redirects. No rating found on-site or on Firmy.cz. This is an open question, not a negative finding.
findings.recommendation: Manual GBP login check; confirm a tree-care-specific primary category.

findings.title: Firmy.cz/Mapy.cz category is generic
findings.description: Both listings filed under 'Údržba zeleně a rekultivace'.
findings.recommendation: Change to the most specific tree-care category available.

findings.title: No review signal anywhere
findings.description: No aggregateRating and no visible rating or count on any of 30 pages.
findings.recommendation: Confirm the real review count, then prioritize acquisition.

findings.title: Two addresses in one LocalBusiness node
findings.description: src/app/page.js:35-47 and :67-79 use arrays for address and geo.
findings.recommendation: Split into two nodes, or Organization + branchOf.

findings.title: No insurance statement
findings.description: Searched all 30 pages for 'pojišt/pojist' — zero matches. A standard Czech trust signal for felling work.
findings.recommendation: Add near the ETW credential.

findings.title: Founding date vs ARES
findings.description: Schema says foundingDate 2011; ARES records the s.r.o. as founded 2020-09-17. Likely a predecessor OSVČ.
findings.recommendation: Add one clarifying sentence.

findings.title: Do not build city landing pages
findings.description: The 17 place-named realization pages already carry real content and photos; templated city pages would fail the doorway-page gate at this size.
findings.recommendation: No action — deliberate non-recommendation.

categories.name: Search Experience (unweighted)
what_works: Page-type fit is broadly correct for most arborist queries
Case studies name prestigious clients and carry a working per-case CTA

findings.title: No pricing page at all
findings.description: Zero 'Kč' across 30 pages; every result for 'kácení stromů cena' is a dedicated ceník page. One qualitative line sits buried in a homepage FAQ accordion (src/data/faq.js:18-20).
findings.recommendation: Add /cenik or price-range content per service.

findings.title: Response-time promise contradicts emergency positioning
findings.description: src/components/ContactUs.js:53,84 promises next business day.
findings.recommendation: Reconcile with the emergency-felling messaging.

findings.title: Homepage cannibalizes a service page
findings.description: Both compete for 'štěpkování dřevní hmoty Praha'.
findings.recommendation: Differentiate targeting.

categories.name: Visual / Mobile (unweighted)
what_works: No horizontal overflow at 360, 375, 650, 651 or 1920
650px breakpoint switches cleanly
Hero contrast legible; H1 above the fold on every page type

findings.title: Cookie banner covers the primary CTA on mobile
findings.description: Occupies y=672-812 in an 812px viewport, clipping 'Chci nabídku zdarma' mid-button on every page type.
findings.recommendation: Slim bar or bottom sheet that does not overlap content.

findings.title: Phone number off-screen on mobile
findings.description: Header phone link measures left:415 at 375px width — inside the closed drawer. The first screen shows only a logo and a hamburger.
findings.recommendation: Persistent tap-to-call in src/layouts/NavBar.js.

findings.title: Hamburger is a 24x24 tap target
findings.description: Against the 44x44 guidance.
findings.recommendation: Increase the hit area.

findings.title: Service pages open as a wall of bold text
findings.description: No image, no CTA, no phone above the fold on mobile.
findings.recommendation: Add an intro visual and a visible CTA.

categories.name: Backlinks (insufficient data)
what_works: Domain is present in Common Crawl and in its rankings — no penalty signal

findings.title: Free tier only — no link index
findings.description: Moz, Bing Webmaster and DataForSEO all unconfigured. Common Crawl exposes no referring-domain list, so no inbound link could be named and no toxicity screen was possible. PageRank rank ~23.9M — normal sparsity for a small local site.
findings.recommendation: Sign up for the free Moz API to get a real referring-domain count.

findings.title: Link-acquisition opening
findings.description: src/data/realizations.js names Zámek Kozel, Zámek Nebílovy, Zámek Vlachovo Březí, Týnský chrám, ČEZ and nine municipalities.
findings.recommendation: Offer those organizations the already-published case-study photos and text.

phases.name: Phase 0: Settle the unknown
items: Log in and check the Google Business Profile — existence, verification, primary category, review count
Decide deliberately whether the Cloudflare AI-crawler block matches business intent

phases.name: Phase 1: Critical Fixes
items: Re-encode public/images/realizace/* to ~1200-1600px WebP q75-80; add priority and sizes to the realization hero
Add tap-to-call to the mobile header; stop the cookie banner covering the primary CTA; enlarge the hamburger hit area
Add alternates.canonical to every metadata export; delete the dead canonical hook

phases.name: Phase 2: High-Impact Improvements
items: Publish pricing — a /cenik page or price ranges per service
Cross-link services and realizations; add the missing footer link; make the service CTA a real link
Move trust signals off the homepage to /o-nas and /kontakt; add an insurance statement
Reconcile the experience claim to one computed source; explain the 2011 vs 2020 ARES distinction
Fix the schema errors: postalCode, @id linking, numeric geo, the sameAs mis-link

phases.name: Phase 3: Content & Authority
items: Deepen the service pages, starting with inventarizace-drevin; give each a topical H2
Add BreadcrumbList, WebSite and Article schema
Outreach to the named castles, ČEZ and municipalities using the existing case studies
Correct the Firmy.cz/Mapy.cz categories; claim zivefirmy.cz, najisto.cz, edb.cz

phases.name: Phase 4: Monitoring & Iteration
items: Replace the hand-maintained sitemap with src/app/sitemap.js generated from the data files
Add HSTS and CSP at the Cloudflare edge; cache /images/* for 1 year immutable
Housekeeping: drop the hardcoded robots meta, remove duplicate GA4, 301 the legacy .html URL, fix the H1 spacing, translate the 404 page
Connect Search Console and a free Moz API key to close the measurement gap
Capture a drift baseline so future deploys can be diffed
